content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts exhibit significant mean-reversion bias, failing to capture sharp price spikes in the EU ETS.", "Sentiment values above 0.67 consistently precede upward price movements that the model underestimates.", "Forecasts lag behind true outcomes during bullish trends, showing a systematic downward bias.", "When sentiment drops to negative or zero, the model overestimates prices by ignoring subsequent corrections.", "The model fails to adapt to volatility, maintaining a flat trajectory while true prices oscillate.", "Correction rules should increase forecast sensitivity to positive sentiment shifts to reduce underestimation.", "Apply a mean-reversion penalty to forecasts when sentiment history shows a sudden drop from high levels.", "Adjust forecasts upward by 5-10% when recent sentiment is predominantly positive to align with actual market spikes."]}
